trusted_proxy.explain1: When PocketBase is deployed on platforms like Fly or it is accessible through proxies such as NGINX, requests from different users will originate from the same IP address (the IP of the proxy connecting to your PocketBase app).
trusted_proxy.explain2: In this case to retrieve the actual user IP (used for rate limiting, logging, etc.) you need to properly configure your proxy and list below the trusted headers that PocketBase could use to extract the user IP.

trusted_proxy.recommend1: use headers that are controlled only by the proxy and cannot be manually set by the users
trusted_proxy.recommend2: make sure that the PocketBase server can be accessed ONLY through the proxy
